policy.profile_storage: Each accepted signature-verification profile is an immutable strict-UTF-8 JSON document with no BOM, retained in the PatentGrantBundle as evidence/identity/sha256/<sha256-of-exact-profile-bytes>.

required_semantics.key_material_profile: exact accepted key/certificate byte grammar and canonical decoding rules
required_semantics.certificate_profile: exact certificate/container parsing, field interpretation, critical-extension handling and rejection rules, or explicit none
required_semantics.signature_encoding: exact signature byte grammar and canonical decoding rules
required_semantics.signed_bytes: complete deterministic algorithm selecting the exact source bytes covered by authentication
required_semantics.digest_algorithm: single exact digest algorithm or explicit none when the signature primitive hashes internally
required_semantics.signature_algorithm: single exact cryptographic signature primitive and parameters
required_semantics.verification_algorithm: complete deterministic verification procedure including canonical parsing, scalar/point/integer bounds, padding/encoding checks and one acceptance condition
required_semantics.chain_validation: complete deterministic trust-anchor and certificate-chain procedure, or explicit direct-key mode
required_semantics.rejection_rules: all malformed, ambiguous, noncanonical, weak, unsupported or multiply interpretable inputs fail closed

policy.trust_binding: An accepted ISO trust-anchor/edition rule must name the exact signature_profile_id and signature_profile_sha256 for the authentication artifact and source media type.
policy.release_binding: The signed identity attestation and release record must bind the exact signature-registry version/hash and signature-profile id/hash; the exact registry/profile bytes are retained in the bundle.
policy.implementation_rule: A crypto-library name or version is diagnostic only and never defines acceptance semantics. The retained profile controls; an implementation that cannot prove conformance to every profile check must fail closed.
policy.note: No locally named, ambient, latest, implementation-defined, or unlisted ISO signature verifier is conforming. This registry intentionally contains no profiles until an ISO-issued authentication format and a strict reviewed verification procedure are available.
